name: Weirds
description: Semi-sentient walking paradoxes created by Niv-Mizzet from elementals of opposing elements, used as lab assistants.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet, bored with the squabbling elementalists, combines opposing elements to create the first weirds.
timeline.quote: The dragon , bored with the squabbling of the various elementalists , combined opposing elements to create the paradoxical creatures.
